_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: OpenRCT2
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The open-source RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, hosting a park for players to build together. Installs any OpenRCT2 release, checked against GitHub's checksum, and picks up the latest autosave at start.
startup: save="{{SAVE_URI}}"; if [ "{{LOAD_AUTOSAVE}}" = true ]; then a=$(ls -t ServerData/save/autosave/*.park 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -z "$a" ] || save=$a; fi; echo "Hosting $save"; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./OpenRCT2 exec ./OpenRCT2/openrct2-cli host "$save" --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --user-data-path /home/container/ServerData/

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenRCT2. Downloads the chosen OpenRCT2 release's Linux build from its
# GitHub releases (checked against GitHub's checksum), and Debian's libzip,
# which it needs (checked against Debian's). Your parks, saves and settings
# in ServerData/ are never touched; the game is replaced only once the new
# download has arrived whole.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "OpenRCT2 publishes Linux builds for x86-64 only."
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "${VERSION:-latest}" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "OpenRCT2 has no release ${VERSION:-latest}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as v0.5.7."
# The build for Debian 13, which the server's image runs.
asset="OpenRCT2-$tag-Linux-trixie-x86_64.tar.gz"
grep -q "^$asset " <<<"$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag")" ||
    fail "OpenRCT2 $tag has no build for this server's system (Debian 13). Choose a newer version."

if [ -x OpenRCT2/openrct2-cli ] && [ -f OpenRCT2/libzip.so.5 ] && [ "$(cat OpenRCT2/.raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "OpenRCT2 $tag is already installed."
else
    rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/x" "$build/zip"
    echo "Downloading OpenRCT2 $tag"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/o.tar.gz" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$build/o.tar.gz" -C "$build/x"
    [ -x "$build/x/OpenRCT2/openrct2-cli" ] || fail "OpenRCT2 $tag's download has no server in it. Choose another version."
    rm -f "$build/x/OpenRCT2/openrct2"   # the game client

    # libzip, from Debian 13 like the rest of the image.
    pkg=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/trixie/main/binary-amd64/Packages.xz | xz -d |
        awk -v RS= '/(^|\n)Package: libzip5\n/') || fail "Debian's package list can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    file=$(sed -n 's/^Filename: //p' <<<"$pkg") sum=$(sed -n 's/^SHA256: //p' <<<"$pkg")
    [ -n "$file" ] && [ -n "$sum" ] || fail "Debian's package list has no libzip. Reinstall to try again later."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/libzip.deb" "https://deb.debian.org/debian/$file" || fail "The download of libzip failed. Reinstall to try again."
    [ "$(sha256sum "$build/libzip.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "libzip didn't match Debian's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    dpkg-deb -x "$build/libzip.deb" "$build/zip"
    cp -a "$build/zip/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/"libzip.so.5* "$build/x/OpenRCT2/"

    echo "$tag" > "$build/x/OpenRCT2/.raptor-version"
    rm -rf OpenRCT2 && mv "$build/x/OpenRCT2" OpenRCT2
fi

# A park to start with: OpenRCT2 can't make one without the original game.
mkdir -p ServerData/save
if [ ! -f ServerData/save/save.park ]; then
    echo "Downloading a starting park"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o ServerData/save/save.park.part https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/openrct2/save.park ||
        fail "The starting park's download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    mv ServerData/save/save.park.part ServerData/save/save.park
fi
echo "Installed OpenRCT2 $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The OpenRCT2 release, such as v0.5.7, or latest for the newest: the same one your players have. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Park
variables.description: The park to host: a .park, .sv6 or .sv4 file in the server's folder, or a link to one.

variables.name: Load latest autosave
variables.description: true to host the newest autosave instead of the park, when there is one, so the park carries on after a restart.

variables.name: Autosave interval
variables.description: 0 every minute, 1 every 5 minutes, 2 every 15, 3 every 30, 4 every hour, 5 never.

variables.name: Autosaves to keep
variables.description: How many autosaves to keep before the oldest is deleted.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: true to list the server in OpenRCT2's server list.

variables.name: Pause when empty
variables.description: true to pause the park while nobody is connected.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description players see in the server list.

variables.name: Server player name
variables.description: The server shows in the player list as a player with this name.

variables.name: Greeting
variables.description: The message players get when they join.

variables.name: Provider name
variables.description: Who runs the server, shown in the server's details.

variables.name: Provider email
variables.description: An email address shown in the server's details.

variables.name: Provider website
variables.description: A website shown in the server's details.

variables.name: Log chat
variables.description: true to log the chat to ServerData/chatlogs.

variables.name: Log actions
variables.description: true to log what players do to ServerData/serverlogs.
